title: Lawn-Crew Sanitation Surcharge on Pet Registrations: Community Rules & Site Care Grounds Note
content:
While the plan's crew tends the lawn, a lawn-crew sanitation surcharge is added to the registration-year fee of a pet under Community Rules & Site Care:

- when the plan in force includes lawn fertilization and a plan fee is dated within the 1 calendar month ending on the handling date, the surcharge is $15.00;
- when the plan in force includes mowing but not fertilization and a plan fee is dated within that month, the surcharge is $10.00;
- otherwise — a plan without crew mowing or fertilization, or no plan fee dated within that month — there is no surcharge.

Whether the plan includes mowing or fertilization is read from the plan's included upkeep; the plan fees are read from the plan record's statement.

## Truth table

| Plan in force includes fertilization | Plan in force includes mowing | A plan fee dated within the 1 calendar month ending on the handling date | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | any | yes | $15.00 |
| no | yes | yes | $10.00 |
| no | no | any | none |
| any | any | no | none |

## Hypothetical cases

- Handling date 9 October, most recent plan fee dated 1 October, plan includes mowing and fertilization: $15.00.
- Same handling date, most recent plan fee dated 1 September, plan includes mowing only: 1 September lies outside the month ending 9 October, so there is no surcharge.
